claim: Item 0308 requires the recipient be in receipt of special pay during the period of action
quote: Receiving special pay (i.e., IDP, HFP, or HDP), or qualifying for a campaign medal do not in themselves make a person eligible for the BSM
fix: The test is service in an area where HFP, IDP or HDP was authorized, plus personal exposure to hostile action. Receipt of pay alone does not qualify. Reword the question.
